reason: Test checks optional field is cleanly omitted; PR fixes JIT fastpass leaking a swallowed issue's value. At base (before fix), the leaked value appears in output, so test fails.
Same test as js_0003 but at head (after fix). The fix guards both the issues concat and the value assignment, so the optional field is cleanly omitted.
Test expects tab-only line to split paragraphs; PR fixes the paragraph regex to treat tab-only lines as blank. At base, the regex only matches space-only lines, so tabs merge paragraphs.
Same test at head. The regex now includes [ \t]+\n, so a tab-only line correctly separates paragraphs.
Test checks JSON response body is parsed as object; PR fixes non-string stack handling in request error decoration. Core JSON parsing is unrelated to the error-decoration fix.
Same test at head. The fix is unrelated to default JSON response parsing, so test passes on both sides.
Test checks boolean flag recognition; PR fixes uppercase E exponent in number args. Boolean flag parsing is unrelated to numeric exponent handling.
Same test at head. Boolean flag parsing is unaffected by the exponent fix.
Test expects non-ASCII digits to be rejected during integer deserialization; PR adds that rejection. At base, full-width Unicode digits are accepted, so test fails.
Same test at head. The fix rejects non-ASCII digits in JsonTreeReader.nextInt/nextLong, matching test expectations.
Test expects a hyphenated schema name to be applied as a single name; PR fixes config parsing for search_path with hyphens. At base, the parser likely splits or mangles the hyphenated name.
Same test at head. The fix correctly parses search_path values containing hyphens or accented characters.
Test checks image transformation eligibility; PR fixes a resource leak in ByteBufferUtil.fromStream. Image transformation logic is unrelated to the stream resource leak fix.
Same test at head. The resource leak fix does not affect image transformation behavior.
Test checks allowed_symbols configuration; PR caches allowedSymbolsAndAlphanumerics. Caching should preserve the same behavior.
Same test at head. The caching optimization preserves correct allowed-symbols behavior.
Test checks SVG data URI loading; PR fixes GCC 15 compilation by including <cstdint>. Runtime SVG rendering is unrelated to a C++ header include fix.
Test checks datetime shift across DST; PR adds weeks to Afrikaans locale. Datetime arithmetic is unrelated to locale additions.
Same test at head. The GCC 15 compilation fix does not affect SVG data URI runtime behavior.
Test checks form-urlencoded decoding with empty body; PR fixes Cookie header parsing. Form-urlencoded decoding is unrelated to Cookie header handling.
Same test at head. The Cookie header fix does not affect form-urlencoded decoding behavior.
Test checks non-empty directory removal rejection; PR fixes spelling errors. Behavior is unrelated to spelling corrections.
Same test at head. Spelling fixes do not change filesystem behavior.
Test checks schema index rename comparison; PR fixes JSON flags passed as depth. Schema comparison logic is unrelated to JSON flag handling.
Same test at head. The JSON flags fix does not affect schema comparison behavior.
Test checks datetime shift across DST; PR adds weeks to Afrikaans locale. Datetime arithmetic is unrelated to locale additions.
Test checks rate limiter permit replenishment; PR fixes a permit leak in CircuitBreaker. Rate limiter's own replenishment is likely unrelated to CircuitBreaker's leak.
Same test at head. The CircuitBreaker permit leak fix does not affect rate limiter replenishment behavior.
Test checks var-to-block-scoped autofix; PR fixes ASI hazard in prefer-template autofix. The var-to-let/const fix is unrelated to prefer-template.
Same test at head. The prefer-template ASI fix does not affect var-to-block-scoped autofix behavior.
Test checks sitemap spider URL resumption; PR fixes log message mangling. Spider crawling behavior is unrelated to log formatting.
Same test at head. The log formatting fix does not affect spider crawling behavior.
Test checks double-width character printing; PR fixes bidi control character sanitization. Double-width character rendering is unrelated to bidi sanitization.
Same test at head. The bidi control character fix does not affect double-width character rendering.
Test checks symlink creation for metadata outputs; PR optimizes RFC5424 structured data parsing. Symlink behavior is unrelated to log parsing.
Same test at head. The RFC5424 parsing optimization does not affect symlink behavior.
Test checks connection pool creation locking; PR avoids virtual-thread yield spin in ConcurrentBag. Pool creation locking behavior is likely unrelated to yield spin optimization.
Same test at head. The yield spin optimization does not change pool creation locking behavior.
Test checks Redis background save on 32-bit; PR fixes ACL key checks for SORT. Background save is unrelated to ACL key checks.
Same test at head. The ACL fix does not affect background save behavior.
Test checks CTRL-A number increment; PR fixes nvim_win_set_buf changing global CWD. Number increment is unrelated to window buffer CWD behavior.
Same test at head. The CWD fix does not affect number increment/decrement behavior.
Test checks array concat with NULL; PR fixes file cache race condition. Array concatenation is unrelated to file cache blocks.
Same test at head. The file cache fix does not affect array concatenation behavior.
Test checks RefCounted NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE; PR fixes ScrollBar drag scrolling. RefCounted lifecycle is unrelated to ScrollBar input handling.
Same test at head. The ScrollBar fix does not affect RefCounted notification behavior.
Test checks f_regression for constant feature; PR raises error for categorical features with absolute_error. f_regression is unrelated to DecisionTree criterion handling.
Same test at head. The categorical criterion fix does not affect r_regression behavior for constant columns.
Test checks Vault Agent file sink permissions; PR fixes Swagger UI input. File sink permissions are unrelated to UI fixes.
Same test at head. The Swagger UI fix does not affect file sink permission behavior.
Test expects 'Usage: cli' exactly; PR fixes spurious trailing characters in write_usage. At base, the usage line likely has trailing spaces or extra characters.
Same test at head. The fix strips spurious characters and normalizes separators, producing the expected 'Usage: cli'.
Test checks view returning dict as JSON; PR fixes IPv6 address parsing. JSON response rendering is unrelated to host/port parsing.
Same test at head. The IPv6 fix does not affect JSON response behavior.
Test checks required field validation; PR fixes unhashable generic aliases. Required field validation is unrelated to generic alias hashing.
Same test at head. The generic alias fix does not affect required field validation behavior.

Same test at head. The WARN→WARNING rename preserves the same log level, so behavior is identical.

Same test at head. The thread safety fix preserves performance behavior for computed attribute access.
Test expects one entry per listener invocation; PR fixes memory leak in TraceableEventDispatcher. At base, the dispatcher likely tracks per unique listener instead of per invocation.
Same test at head. The fix correctly tracks one entry per invocation, matching test expectations.
Test checks shell completion hook receives correct command; PR fixes shellcheck errors. Shellcheck fixes typically preserve behavior while improving code quality.
Same test at head. The shellcheck fixes preserve completion hook behavior.
Test expects 25 repeated keys to produce an array; PR upgrades qs to 6.14.0. Older qs versions convert arrays to objects beyond 20 items, so base fails.
Same test at head. qs 6.14.0 correctly handles arrays with more than 20 repeated keys.
Test checks get_environ_proxies with URL only; PR adds no_proxy support to proxies argument. The utility function's basic behavior is unrelated to the new feature.
Same test at head. The no_proxy feature addition does not affect basic get_environ_proxies behavior.

Same test at head. The parser fix correctly handles bare words starting with a period.

Same test at head. The fix prevents sink connection for HEAD requests, avoiding the fatal error.
Test expects match-failure diff for map with improper list; PR fixes map formatting in list assertions. At base, the formatter likely crashes or produces incorrect output for maps in improper lists.
Same test at head. The fix correctly formats maps in list assertions, producing the expected diff.

Same test at head. The fix removes the problematic teardown, preserving CSS custom properties across re-renders.
Test checks multi-line URL asset bundling; PR refactors to use hook filters. The refactor preserves asset bundling behavior.
Same test at head. The hook filter refactor preserves multi-line URL asset bundling behavior.

Same test at head. The FZF_CURRENT_ITEM export does not affect preview command behavior with NUL bytes.

Same test at head. The new check correctly identifies this as a valid pattern and reports no error.

Same test at head. The fix grows the destination slice correctly, avoiding the panic.
Test expects mocked time to use application's default timezone; PR fixes timezone fallback. At base, the mock uses the input's timezone instead of the application default.
Same test at head. The fix falls back to the application's default timezone for mocked time.

Same test at head. The expanded regexp correctly recognizes unusual protocol-relative forms.
Test checks MD5 digest of 'abc'; PR optimizes hash combining internals. MD5 computation is unrelated to the combineOrdered/Unordered optimization.
Same test at head. The internal optimization does not affect MD5 digest computation.
Test checks HTTP client source generation; PR refactors diagnostics to dedicated class. The refactor preserves source generation behavior.
Same test at head. The diagnostics refactor preserves client source generation behavior.
Test checks HTTP/1.1 response body fetching; PR removes redundant continue statements. Removing redundant continues preserves identical behavior.
Same test at head. The redundant continue removal preserves HTTP response behavior.

Same test at head. The fix preserves the requested :basic format for non-Gregorian calendar dates.
Test expects end property to update after setEndDate(); PR fixes PHP 8.2+ end property. At base, the native end property shows the old value on PHP 8.2+.
Same test at head. The fix correctly updates the native end property on PHP 8.2+.
Test expects newline in URL path to be rejected; PR adds validation. At base, the client transmits the request with embedded newlines.

Same test at head. The Albanian locale fix does not affect English number conversion.

Same test at head. The property loading fix does not affect singleton DI resolution.
Test checks ordered dictionary key replacement; PR refactors to share replace primitive. The refactor preserves replacement behavior.
Same test at head. The shared primitive preserves ordered dictionary replacement behavior.
Test checks invalid size string returns 0; PR replaces manual check with built-in max. Both produce the same clamping behavior.
Same test at head. The built-in max preserves the same clamping behavior for invalid sizes.
Test expects case-insensitive redirect to resolve correctly; PR fixes panic in findCaseInsensitivePathRec. At base, the server panics with 'invalid node type'.
Same test at head. The fix handles the wildcard child case correctly, avoiding the panic.

Same test at head. The fix treats nil Int as zero, matching Float64Value and other methods.
Test checks prompt shutdown; PR fixes tab stop restoration. Shutdown behavior is unrelated to renderer tab stops.
Same test at head. The tab stop fix does not affect shutdown behavior.

Same test at head. The ignore file optimization does not affect case-insensitive search behavior.
